questions.question: What does the following sentence mean? 'She _____ her hair every morning.'
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb in brackets. 'I (go) to school _____ Monday and Friday.'
Which sentence is correct? 'A: What time _____ you _____ home yesterday? B: I _____ at 6 o'clock.'
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence: 'The _____ of the book was very interesting.'
What is the correct article to use before 'the library'? 'I like _____ library because it’s quiet.'
Which sentence uses the correct preposition? 'She is looking _____ her new job.'
Complete the sentence with the correct pronoun: '______ saw the accident. We just drove past.'
What is the correct form of the verb to complete the sentence? 'If I _____ enough time, I would finish the project.'
Which sentence is grammatically correct? 'A: Where _____ you _____ last weekend? B: We _____ to the park.'
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb: 'She _____ (eat) breakfast before she left for work.'
